card.text: Explore Ariel in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect source-backed Voyager imagery of Uranus’s moon and its orbit.

introduction.text: Ariel is an icy moon crossed by long fault valleys and troughs. Voyager 2 revealed a landscape of cratered plains, deep canyons, and smoother terrain reshaped by past geologic activity.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness correction reduces broad shading, while local shadows and seams remain. The gray grid marks missing observations.

elevation.title: Stereo, shading and limb terrain model
elevation.summary: Height from stereo images, shading and limb measurements. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing elevation data.
